title: Fix derived next-action terminal invariant
objective: Fix the source-level defect that leaves or recreates a stale next-unsatisfied-requirement action after objective completion, while preserving recovery history and allowing later objective revisions to establish valid work again.
scope: derived next-action lifecycle logic in src/cli.js and src/state.js
direct deterministic regression coverage in tests/operator-controls.test.js and tests/recovery-policy.test.js

may: inspect current lifecycle, recovery, status, objective, evaluation, and validation code
introduce a narrow shared derivation helper if useful
modify objective revision, task evaluation, recovery, status, and validation behavior only as required by the invariant
run focused tests and the full deterministic verifier
may_not: modify .opsle runtime authority, historical events, decisions, evidence, requirements, objective history, policy, or supervisor identity
modify unrelated source, tests, documentation, package scripts, or sibling repositories
weaken completion, Acceptance, recovery, claim, fencing, Gearbox, Runner, or Context Firewall behavior
deploy, merge, push, create a PR, or install server-wide

relevant_context: evaluateTask currently writes Select the next unsatisfied requirement slice after every accepted task
task-bind-tmux-supervisor-model was accepted after phase COMPLETE and overwrote the earlier terminal action
setObjective with no active task records history but currently leaves phase COMPLETE and retains the prior derived action
Recovery correctly classified the observed state as no_active_work and must not rewrite historical event records
Canonical terminal representation should be pending_next_action null and human status should report next: none
expected_deliverable: Narrow source correction and regression tests enforcing that COMPLETE with zero unsatisfied requirements has no automatic next action, survives recovery/reconstruction, validates cheaply, and reopens correctly on objective revision.
expected_evidence: COMPLETE plus zero unsatisfied requirements yields pending_next_action null
objective revision from COMPLETE reopens a valid next action
validator rejects only contradictory current state, not historical event text
acceptance_criteria: root cause is corrected in derivation rather than only patching .opsle/state.json
task acceptance cannot recreate the stale action in terminal state
fresh status reconstruction reports no automatic action
objective revision or active requirement state can derive valid work again
current-state validation cheaply detects terminal contradiction
historical events and decisions remain untouched
focused and full deterministic verification pass
prohibited_actions: editing historical event or decision content
release, merge, deployment, or cross-repository initialization
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
